author: nickyeow

english.text: Come to think of it, I promised to see him at five.

jyutping: nam2 nam2 haa5 ngo5 hou2 ci5 joek3 zo2 keoi5 ng5 dim2 gin3 min6 wo3。
text: 諗諗吓我好似約咗佢五點見面喎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He would still be alive if he had been wearing his seat belt when the car crashed.

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 zong6 ce1 go2 zan6 daai3 zo2 on1 cyun4 daai2，zau6 m4 wui5 mou5 zo2 tiu4 meng6。

english.text: We have no school today.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 m4 sai2 faan1 hok6。

author: nickyeow

english.text: China is much larger than Japan.

jyutping: zung1 gwok3 daai6 gwo3 jat6 bun2 hou2 do1。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Human beings differ from animals in that they can think and speak.

jyutping: jan4 leoi6 sik1 dak1 nam2 je5 tung4 gong2 je5，daan6 hai6 dung6 mat6 zau6 m4 sik1。ni1 go3 zau6 hai6 jan4 leoi6 tung4 dung6 mat6 ge3 fan1 bit6 laa3。
text: 人類識得諗嘢同講嘢，但係動物就唔識。呢個就係人類同動物嘅分別喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: This song reminds me of my childhood.

jyutping: ne1 sau2 go1 ling6 ngo5 nam2 faan1 hei2 ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 di1 je5。
text: 呢首歌令我諗返起我細個嗰陣啲嘢。

english.text: I felt out of place in the expensive restaurant.

jyutping: ngo5 hai2 gaan1 gou1 kap1 caan1 teng1 dou6 gok3 dak1 hou2 m4 zi6 zoi6。

english.text: Can you read that sign ahead of us?

author: nickyeow

english.text: I am at home.

jyutping: ngo5 hai2 uk1 kei2。

english.text: Intelligent people are often arrogant.

english.text: Shoes have long since stopped serving only their utilitarian purpose. Over the centuries, shoes have evolved not just to protect feet but also to declare their owners' social status — and sometimes to be worn as treasured objects of art. To honor humanity's sometimes pricey passion for shoes and trace the world's history through footwear, New York's Historical Society has opened a new exhibit, appropriately called, "Walk This Way."

jyutping: haai4 zou2 ji5 m4 zoi3 zi2 hai6 wai6 zo2 keoi5 dei6 ge3 gung1 nang4 sing3 muk6 dik1，hai2 gei2 go3 sai3 gei2 ji5 lai4，haai4 ge3 zeon3 faa3 m4 daan1 zi2 hai6 wai6 zo2 bou2 wu6 goek3，jik6 dou1 hai6 wai6 zo2 syun1 bou3 keoi5 dei6 ge3 zyu2 jan4 ge3 se5 wui2 dei6 wai6 — jau5 si4 zung6 ho2 ji5 dong1 hai6 zan1 gwai3 ge3 ngai6 seot6 ban2 gam2 zoek6 wai6 zo2 haai4 fun2，tung4 maai4 tau3 gwo3 haai4 leoi6 zeoi1 sou3 sai3 gaai3 lik6 si2，nau2 joek3 lik6 si2 hok6 wui2 hoi1 cit3 zo2 jat1 go3 san1 ge3 zin2 laam5，giu3 zou6「Walk This Way」。
text: 鞋早已唔再只係為咗佢哋嘅功能性目的，喺幾個世紀以嚟，鞋嘅進化唔單止係為咗保護腳，亦都係為咗宣布佢哋嘅主人嘅社會地位 — 有時仲可以當係珍貴嘅藝術品噉着 為咗鞋款，同埋透過鞋類追溯世界歷史，紐約歷史學會開設咗一個新嘅展覽，叫做「Walk This Way」。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Money never made a man happy yet, nor will it. There is nothing in its nature to produce happiness. The more a man has, the more he wants. Instead of its filling a vacuum, it makes one. If it satisfies one want, it doubles and trebles that want another way. That was a true proverb of the wise man, rely upon it: "Better is little with the fear of the Lord, than great treasure, and trouble therewith."

jyutping: cin4 cung4 loi4 dou1 mou5 ling6 dou3 naam4 jan2 hoi1 sam1，jik6 dou1 m4 wui5。keoi5 bun2 zat1 soeng6 mou5 je5 ho2 ji5 caan2 saang1 hang6 fuk1。naam4 jan2 jung2 jau5 ge3 je5 jyut6 do1，keoi5 soeng2 jiu3 ge3 je5 zau6 jyut6 do1。keoi5 m4 hai6 tin4 bou2 jat1 go3 zan1 hung1，ji4 hai6 zai3 zou6 jat1 go3。jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 mun5 zuk1 dou3 jat1 go3 jan4 soeng2 jiu3 ge3 je5，keoi5 zau6 wui5 gaa1 pui5 tung4 gou1 jam1 go2 go3 soeng2 jiu3 ling6 jat1 go3 fong1 faat3。ni1 go3 hai6 zi3 ze2 ge3 jat1 geoi3 zan1 zing3 ge3 jin6 jyu5，jiu3 kaau3 keoi5：「ging3 wai3 zyu2 ge3 si6，hou2 gwo3 jau5 daai6 bou2 mat6 tung4 ceoi4 zi1 ji4 loi4 ge3 maa4 faan4。」
text: 錢從來都冇令到男人開心，亦都唔會。佢本質上冇嘢可以產生幸福。男人擁有嘅嘢越多，佢想要嘅嘢就越多。佢唔係填補一個真空，而係製造一個。如果佢滿足到一個人想要嘅嘢，佢就會加倍同高音嗰個想要另一個方法。呢個係智者嘅一句真正嘅諺語，要靠佢：「敬畏主嘅事，好過有大寶物同隨之而來嘅麻煩。」
